note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a PER 3(1), Supreme Decree no. 004-97-IN 8(a), 15 (revoked by Law 27532 in 2001?); A06b PER 3(1), Supreme Decree no. 004-97-IN 8(a), 15 (revoked by Law 27532 in 2001?); L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 2 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: No provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Generational transmission restriction: conditional on birthplace/place of residence /mode under which parent acquired citizenship), A02a (birth in country: Generally applicable provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: by birth in the territory unconditionally; by descent from either parent, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states (the dataset codes no separate descent rule for a child born in the country, birth there giving it; the parent's sex is read from mode A01b). Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file. On 2026-11-03 the primary was read: Ley N° 26574, Ley de Nacionalidad (Congreso de la República del Perú, Archivo Digital de la Legislación; scan of the text as published in El Peruano, 1996), arts. 2, 3, 7, 9. Every figure the file holds now rests on it, and the dataset is no longer cited. Read on the page image of El Peruano of 11 January 1996 (the scan has no text layer). The limit abroad is now arts. 2(3) and 4(3)'s words.

sources.title: Ley N° 26574, Ley de Nacionalidad (Congreso de la República del Perú, Archivo Digital de la Legislación; scan of the text as published in El Peruano, 1996), arts. 2, 3, 7, 9
sources.said: Articulo 2°.- Son peruanos por nacimiento: 1. Las personas nacidas en el territorio de la Republica ... 3. Las personas nacidas en territorio extranjero, hijos de padre o madre peruanos de nacimiento, que sean inscritos durante su minoria de edad en el respectivo Registro del Estado Civil, Sección Nacimientos, de la Oficina Consular del Peru. El derecho otorgado en el numeral 3 es reconocido solo a los descendientes hasta la tercera generacion. Articulo 3°.- Son peruanos por naturalización: 1. ... a) Residir legalmente en el territorio de la Republica por lo menos dos años consecutivos. ... Articulo 7°.- La nacionalidad peruana se pierde por renuncia expresa ante autoridad competente. ... Articulo 9°.- Los peruanos de nacimiento que adoptan la nacionalidad de otro pais, no pierden su nacionalidad, salvo que hagan renuncia expresa de ella ante autoridad competente.

atBirth.descentAbroad: Person is born abroad to a Peruvian-by-birth father or mother and is registered at the Peruvian consulate during minority (descendants to the third generation only); or, born abroad to a Peruvian father or mother, declares for it from majority.
